mapper.select: SELECT quantity FROM wms_batch_location_balance WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo} AND location_id = #{locationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_batch_location_balance(tenant_id, warehouse_id, location_id, batch_no, seller_sku, quantity) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{batch.warehouseId}, #{locationId}, #{batch.batchNo}, #{batch.sellerSku}, #{quantity}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, batch_no, location_id) DO UPDATE SET quantity = wms_batch_location_balance.quantity + EXCLUDED.quantity
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_purchase_inspection SET putaway_quantity = putaway_quantity + #{quantity} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND batch_no = #{batchNo}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(l.location_code, l.barcode) FROM wms_inventory_transaction t JOIN wms_warehouse_location l ON l.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND l.location_id = t.target_location_id WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND t.seller_sku = #{sellerSku} AND t.transaction_type = 'PURCHASE_PUTAWAY' AND l.enabled AND l.purpose = 'GOOD' AND COALESCE(l.location_code, l.barcode) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1
